title: Yellowed Crispy Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A bitter and dense Saudi Arabian dish featuring sesame seed and lamb, air-fried to perfection for a low-fat friendly meal option. This adventurous dish is perfect for those looking to try something new.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the lamb marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Sprinkle the sesame seeds over the lamb cubes.
Place the skewers in the air fryer basket, leaving some space between each skewer.
Cook the lamb kebabs in the air fryer for 12-15 minutes, or until they are cooked through and crispy on the outside.
Serve the lamb kebabs hot, garnished with additional sesame seeds if desired.
